Synopsis:
Halsin approaches you the morning after you celebrated your victory over the goblins. He now turns to the matter of your tadpole and how you might cure yourself - there is no quick solution, however. He tells you it'll be necessary to travel to a dangerous new region, and joins you at your camp to provide support.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_SCO_HalsinMorningAfter.json: The scene follows the night of celebration after the player helped save the Emerald Grove: Halsin, the Grove’s First Druid, has returned and is meeting the player at camp. He has already sensed the mind‑flayer tadpole in the player, reacts with alarm, and warns there is no quick or safe way to remove it — removal could be lethal — though he promises to try and help. Halsin explains that any cure will require a dangerous journey to Moonrise Towers, which is surrounded by a deadly shadow curse, and so he strongly advises an underground approach. He points to a hidden entrance beneath the ruined temple of Selûne (a route others, including Aradin, have sought) and offers to join the player’s camp to provide guidance and support.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_HalsinReturns.json: The player has just helped save the Emerald Grove—either by repelling an attack or assassinating its leaders—and Halsin, the Grove’s First Druid, has returned to thank them and assess what happened while he was gone. Halsin may be meeting the player for the first time (if the player missed him earlier), and he immediately senses the mind‑flayer tadpole inside the player, reacting with alarm when he finds the player unusually aware and unbowed to the Absolute/True Souls. He warns that the parasite is magically bound to the host (removal could be lethal) but reiterates his promise to help. Celebrations are underway that night; Halsin defers any treatment discussion until the next morning and will join the player’s camp to begin assisting with the trials ahead.
- CAMP_HalsinsReturn_CFM.json: Halsin — the Emerald Grove’s arch‑druid — appears at the player’s camp as the fallback companion when the Grove is locked down or the player’s assault on the den has auto‑completed. Off‑screen he was likely encountered (or freed) recently in the goblin wolf‑pens where he’d been trapped in bear form, so he’s indebted to the player for dealing with the goblin leadership. Using druidic magic he immediately senses the player’s illithid tadpole: he confirms you’re infected but notes an unfamiliar magic is binding the parasite and slowing ceremorphosis, making removal dangerous. Halsin offers to help find a cure and points to Moonrise Towers as the probable source of that corrupting magic, warning the journey will be perilous.
- GOB_WolfPens_HalsinsBear_AfterCombat.json: Halsin, arch-druid of the Emerald Grove, is  freed from the goblins and changes back from bear form, thanking the players. They can ask him about their tadpole problem, but he wants help saving the grove first - either by killing the goblin leadership or defending the grove, whichever is applicable. The player can insist on learning what they can from him to help with their tadpole, if they wish.
- CAMP_Halsin2.json: Thaniel — the spirit of the land — has already been rescued and is resting in your camp, but he is not whole: Halsin has discovered the Shadow curse tore him in two, leaving one corrupted fragment behind in the mortal realm while the other was dragged toward the Shadowfell. Halsin, an avuncular scholar whose mood darkens when he speaks of Moonrise Towers and the curse, explains that the missing half may be twisted and dangerous but should still bear signs of Thaniel’s power (he suggests looking for life — wildflowers — in the darkness). He also mentions a promising lead: a ruin outside Last Light where he saw fresh blooms and will mark your map. Halsin offers his aid and can be recruited as a companion to help you find and restore Thaniel.

The player has just helped save the Emerald Grove—either by repelling an attack or assassinating its leaders—and Halsin, the Grove’s First Druid, has returned to thank them and assess what happened while he was gone. Halsin may be meeting the player for the first time (if the player missed him earlier), and he immediately senses the mind‑flayer tadpole inside the player, reacting with alarm when he finds the player unusually aware and unbowed to the Absolute/True Souls. Halsin — the Emerald Grove’s arch‑druid — appears at the player’s camp as the fallback companion when the Grove is locked down or the player’s assault on the den has auto‑completed. They can ask him about their tadpole problem, but he wants help saving the grove first - either by killing the goblin leadership or defending the grove, whichever is applicable. The player can insist on learning what they can from him to help with their tadpole, if they wish.

He also mentions a promising lead: a ruin outside Last Light where he saw fresh blooms and will mark your map. Halsin offers his aid and can be recruited as a companion to help you find and restore Thaniel.
context: The scene takes place the morning after the player helped save the Emerald Grove and celebrated that victory. Halsin, the Grove’s arch‑druid, has already detected an illithid tadpole in the player and warns there is no safe, quick way to remove it—removal could be lethal because the parasite is magically bound and an unfamiliar magic appears to be slowing ceremorphosis. He tells the player that a cure will likely require travelling to Moonrise Towers, which is ringed by a deadly shadow curse, and strongly advises an underground approach. Halsin points to a hidden entrance beneath the ruined temple of Selûne (a route others, including Aradin, have sought) and offers to join the player’s camp to provide guidance and support for the dangerous journey ahead.
